name: Paint
summary:
Paint gives you a huge bright room with blank walls, a bench full of real painting tools, and nothing to stop you.

THE TOOLS
Spray cans and spray guns lay down soft clouds of colour. The airless sprayer covers a wall in seconds. Rollers put down solid, even coats, and brushes pick out the detail.

THE COLOUR WHEEL
Press X and a wheel of 44 colours opens in front of you. Point the laser, pull the trigger, and your tools are loaded with that colour.
